findings.description: Maria Dorothea Stockburger and Johann Georg Mayer had a son, Andreas Mayer, born and baptised 5 September 1812 at Sankt Georgen, Baden; the baptism index also carries a death date of 29 February 1852 for him.
supporting_sources: Germany, Births and Baptisms, 1558-1898 — baptism entry for Andreas Mayer, 5 Sep 1812, Sankt Georgen, Baden, naming his parents as Johann Georg Mayer and Maria Dorothea Stokburger
